quests.title: Final Match Concludes, Champion Decided

dialogue.section: Kaedehara Kazuha, Sieciech, Gaumaru, Sumire, Onyx Agate, Diminished Seventh Arpeggio

dialogue.t: I believe you have already made up your mind, {NICKNAME}.
Ahem. Let me recall my lines...
This has been a truly spectacular and thrilling competition, and now, it is time to announce the results.
We would like to invite our Final Trial Warden, {NICKNAME}, to name the champion from among the three finalists.
Huh? So {NICKNAME} gets to choose the final winner? Whoa... this has to be a first. Looks like {NICKNAME} has become the most important judge in this challenge!

dialogue.sit: The winner is the cutest little pup, Gaumaru!
I declare Onyx Agate to be the most outstanding competitor of them all.
In my opinion, the winner is Diminished Seventh Arpeggio.

dialogue.t: Oh yeah, Paimon agrees that Gaumaru was the strongest of them all too! There's definitely a bit of Taroumaru in that pup!
Awoo! Awoooo!
Great job, Gaumaru! Your hard work has paid off in the most glorious way!
My sincere congratulations to our two friends from Inazuma. This is a well-deserved win.
I agree. Our peppy little Ninken here was quite a force to be reckoned with indeed.
While we're not holding a grand prize ceremony, I'd say that you all value practical combat and tend to keep a low profile in your daily lives anyway.
This honor coming from {NICKNAME} himself(herself) is just about the highest honor one can receive in Nod-Krai, and one that far surpasses ordinary trophies and medals.
Hehe... You folks are probably the very first in the whole of Teyvat to receive a prize from {NICKNAME} in this manner...
We do not need any pomp or ceremony. This is more than enough.
Isn't that so, Budanova?
Of course! Maybe my people can host the challenge the next time, and make it an even bigger affair.
We should have at least a hundred competitors in the qualifiers to start with. That way, we might be able to discover some unknown or unaffiliated talents.
That makes a lot of sense. The Bombardiers will also be pleased to organize something like this. I shall write up a proposal for Major Valeriy.
The Shuumatsuban will also... Um... If organizing this thing is going to cost tens of millions of Mora, then never mind. But the Ninken troop will take part nevertheless.
Woo...
I thank each and every one of you for your kind offers. However, it is my opinion that once a competition like this is held and funded by a powerful faction, things may be a little different.
Would any of you be able to resist the temptation to recruit any unaffiliated competitor who performs well, for example?
Ah, Kazuha, do you mean...
That's right. The best candidate to host a competition like this would be the relatively neutral Adventurers' Guild.

dialogue.sit: Yes, we have to keep the competition free of any other interests.
He's right. The competition must be held only for competition's sake, and nothing else.

dialogue.t: Yeah... Paimon thinks she gets it too! Allow Paimon to state things bluntly then...
Although the two Fatui contestants this time round have been really polite, some of your colleagues can be super mean, and even get right to attacking us without giving us the chance to speak.
If the Fatui end up running this competition, who's to say they won't end up recruiting the top finishers? And that means we'd basically be... helping you scout out talent to fight against us!
Haha, there's no denying that now...
I hear what you two are saying. But I can't make any promises on behalf of the others.
Different units have different missions and ways of doing things. And the words of this mere junior officer do not hold much weight.
Mr. Kaedehara makes a valid point. And {NICKNAME} and Paimon's concerns are just as understandable.
Alright, you two, stop scheming and just enjoy the thrill of combat like Gaumaru over here!
Ruff! Ruffff!
You are right. A foot soldier like me should leave matters like this to my senior officers and focus solely on combat.
The next time we face off, you can expect to see improvements in my skills!
And I... will make sure to bring enough cake for everyone!

quests.description: The martial arts challenge has come to an end. It is time to decide on the champion…
